_meta.methodology: Confidence tier reuses the Phase 1 audit's manually reviewed classification (§6.1 exact / §6.2 approximate / §6.3 unmatched). The 14 SKUs individually side-by-side verified in the Phase 2 audit (§9) are hardcoded to their confirmed LPM row. All other §6.1 'exact' SKUs are resolved by IDF-weighted token overlap (tokens weighted by inverse document frequency across the 147-product LPM corpus, so generic cosmetic vocabulary like 'hữu cơ'/'chiết xuất' contributes almost nothing and distinctive scent/ingredient words dominate — full Vietnamese diacritics kept throughout to avoid tone-mark homograph collisions). 'medium'/'low' tier (§6.2) candidates are always reviewStatus=needs_manual_review. 'unmatched' (§6.3) gets no candidate.
